item.text: The CSV has one row per swarm replicate and columns for genotype, area, and circularity. The estimand is therefore: group replicates by genotype, compute mean Area and mean Circularity for each genotype, then report the mean Circularity from the genotype with the maximum mean Area. I’m now creating an isolated copy of the seed history and will run both group means in Galaxy.
